glosses: to theorize (to formulate a theory; to speculate)
wyrażać przypuszczenia nie wychodzące poza sferę teorii
To formulate a theory, especially about some specific subject.

examples.text: Derridean "messianicity without messianism" that marks so much of post-modernist educational theorizing today, and that makes use of esotericism, sigetics, acroamatics, proleptics, and illocutionary and perlocutionary acts in the disguise of a new pedagogy of the unknowable, wasn't the answer ten years ago.
There are processes of collective individuation that produce the transindividual in the course of a process of transindividuation (which Simondon does not theorize as such).
Autistic rhetoric scholar Melanie Yergeau theorizes neuroqueer as a kind of “asocially perverse” motioning.
The homeowner theorized that the intruders saw that the house was up for sale and targeted it for their rager.
